mapper.select: SELECT r.role_id AS roleId, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_nm AS roleNm, CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS roleDc, CASE WHEN r.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' THEN 1 WHEN r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS roleLevel, 'Y' AS tenantScoped, 'PLATFORM' AS tenantCode, r.use_at AS useAt, ISNULL(r.is_system_role, 'N') AS systemRoleYn, CASE WHEN ISNULL(r.is_system_role, 'N') = 'Y' THEN CAST(1 AS bit) ELSE CAST(0 AS bit) END AS systemRole, r.created_at AS frstRegistPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS frstRegisterId, r.updated_at AS lastUpdtPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS lastUpdusrId FROM tb_role r ORDER BY roleLevel, roleCode

SELECT r.role_id AS roleId, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_nm AS roleNm, CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS roleDc, CASE WHEN r.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' THEN 1 WHEN r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS roleLevel, 'Y' AS tenantScoped, 'PLATFORM' AS tenantCode, r.use_at AS useAt, ISNULL(r.is_system_role, 'N') AS systemRoleYn, CASE WHEN ISNULL(r.is_system_role, 'N') = 'Y' THEN CAST(1 AS bit) ELSE CAST(0 AS bit) END AS systemRole, r.created_at AS frstRegistPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS frstRegisterId, r.updated_at AS lastUpdtPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS lastUpdusrId FROM tb_role r WHERE 1 = 1
AND r.use_at = #{useAt}
AND r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND r.role_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND r.role_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY roleLevel, roleCode OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_role r WHERE 1 = 1
AND r.use_at = #{useAt}
AND r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND r.role_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND r.role_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT TOP 1 r.role_id AS roleId, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_nm AS roleNm, CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS roleDc, CASE WHEN r.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' THEN 1 WHEN r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS roleLevel, 'Y' AS tenantScoped, 'PLATFORM' AS tenantCode, r.use_at AS useAt, ISNULL(r.is_system_role, 'N') AS systemRoleYn, CASE WHEN ISNULL(r.is_system_role, 'N') = 'Y' THEN CAST(1 AS bit) ELSE CAST(0 AS bit) END AS systemRole, r.created_at AS frstRegistPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS frstRegisterId, r.updated_at AS lastUpdtPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS lastUpdusrId FROM tb_role r WHERE r.role_id = #{value} ORDER BY r.role_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_role ( tenant_id, role_code, role_nm, use_at, is_system_role, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( (SELECT TOP 1 tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = 'PLATFORM' ORDER BY tenant_id), #{roleCode}, #{roleNm}, #{useAt}, ISNULL(#{systemRoleYn}, 'N'), GETDATE(), GETDATE() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_role SET role_nm = #{roleNm}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
UPDATE tb_role SET use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE role_id = #{roleId}

mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id AS menuId, m.menu_code AS menuCode, m.menu_nm AS menuNm, ISNULL(m.menu_dc, '') AS menuDc, m.parent_menu_id AS parentMenuId, m.menu_order AS menuOrdr, m.menu_url AS menuUrl, ISNULL(m.icon_nm, 'Menu') AS iconNm, m.use_at AS useAt, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN p.permission_code = 'PERM_WRITE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'write' ELSE 'read' END AS permissionLevel, 1 AS accessible FROM tb_menu m INNER JOIN tb_role_menu_permission rmp ON m.menu_id = rmp.menu_id INNER JOIN tb_permission p ON rmp.permission_id = p.permission_id INNER JOIN tb_login_account_role lar ON lar.role_id = rmp.role_id INNER JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = lar.login_id INNER JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = lar.role_id WHERE m.use_at = 'Y' AND p.use_at = 'Y' AND la.login_code = #{loginId} AND la.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ISNULL(la.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND ISNULL(r.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' GROUP BY m.menu_id, m.menu_code, m.menu_nm, m.menu_dc, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_order, m.menu_url, m.icon_nm, m.use_at ORDER BY m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_order, m.menu_id
